title: Simple System Menu
description: Build an interactive menu using `case` that lets the user run common commands.
problemStatement:
Write a script `menu.sh` that displays the following menu repeatedly until the user selects 'Quit':

```
1) Show current date and time
2) List files in current directory
3) Show disk usage
4) Show your username
5) Quit
```

Use `read` to get the user's choice, then a `case` statement to execute the corresponding command. For option 3, use `du -sh .` (current directory).

Wrap the menu in an infinite loop (`while true; do ... done`) and break out on option 5. Make sure to give an error message for invalid choices.
hints: Use `while true; do ... done` to loop forever.
Use `case` to match `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, and `*` for default.
Put `clear` at the top to refresh the screen (optional).
expectedOutput: A looping menu that performs actions and only stops when 5 is selected.
